{"id": "sKaLC6A0Igw", "snippet": {"title": "Why Did Northern Rock Collapse? £4.45bn Withdrawn in 3 Days", "categoryId": "27", "description": "Northern Rock collapse explained from court and regulator records: the 2007 bank run that opened Britain's 2008 financial crisis.
Savers withdrew £4.45bn in three days. Using the Treasury Committee's 'The run on the Rock', the Bank of England's statements, the FSA's own internal audit and enforcement notices, the National Audit Office's reports and the shareholder rulings up to Strasbourg, we show why a bank that was solvent on paper ran out of cash, which executives the regulator found failed to correct, or repeated, understated bad-loan figures, why shareholders were paid nothing, and what the rescue finally cost.

Chapters
0:00 Cold open
1:00 The bank that borrowed the world
2:43 The summer the market shut
4:20 The queues
5:57 The taxpayer steps in
7:45 Who was watching?
10:41 Worth nothing
12:29 Our analysis
14:49 Outro

Sources
[1] Treasury Committee, 'The run on the Rock', Fifth Report of Session 2007–08, HC 56-I (Jan 2008), summary: https://books.google.com/books/about/The_run_on_the_Rock.html?id=JilbRcHCXIMC
[2] Bank of England / HM Treasury / FSA, 'Liquidity support facility for Northern Rock plc' (14 Sep 2007): https://www.bankofengland.co.uk/news/2007/september/liquidity-support-facility-for-northern-rock-plc
[3] European Court of Human Rights, Grainger and Others v the United Kingdom, no. 34940/10, decision of 10 Jul 2012: https://lagen.nu/dom/echr/001-112312
[4] Court of Appeal, SRM Global Master Fund & Ors v HM Treasury [2009] EWCA Civ 788: https://caselaw.nationalarchives.gov.uk/ewca/civ/2009/788
[5] Upper Tribunal, Northern Rock Applicants v Caldwell & HM Treasury [2011] UKUT 408 (TCC): https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/media/58e3a9a5ed915d06ac0000c0/Northern_Rock_Applicants_v_Andrew_Caldwell_and_HM_Treasury.pdf
[6] Court of Appeal, Harbinger Capital Partners v Caldwell [2013] EWCA Civ 492: https://caselaw.nationalarchives.gov.uk/ewca/civ/2013/492
[7] FSA, release on its Internal Audit review of Northern Rock supervision (26 Mar 2008), via Mondo Visione: https://mondovisione.com/news/uks-financial-services-authority-moves-to-enhance-supervision-in-wake-of-norther-2011124/
[8] The CFO, 'Risk lessons from the FSA', 21 Apr 2008: https://the-cfo.io/2008/04/21/risk-lessons-from-the-fsa/
[9] FSA Final Notice, David Baker (13 Apr 2010): https://www.fca.org.uk/publication/final-notices/david_baker.pdf
[10] FSA Final Notice, Richard Barclay (13 Apr 2010): https://www.fca.org.uk/publication/final-notices/richard_barclay.pdf
[11] FSA Final Notice, David Jones (27 Jul 2010): https://www.fca.org.uk/publication/final-notices/david_jones.pdf
[12] HM Treasury announcement on Northern Rock (17 Feb 2008), via Mondo Visione: https://mondovisione.com/media-and-resources/news/hm-treasury-announcement-on-northern-rock-2011124/
[13] Banking (Special Provisions) Act 2008: https://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/2008/2/introduction/enacted
[14] National Audit Office, 'HM Treasury: The nationalisation of Northern Rock', HC 298 (20 Mar 2009): https://www.nao.org.uk/reports/hm-treasury-the-nationalisation-of-northern-rock/
[15] National Audit Office, 'The creation and sale of Northern Rock plc', HC 20 (18 May 2012): https://www.nao.org.uk/wp-content/uploads/2012/05/121320.pdf
[16] National Audit Office, 'The £13 billion sale of former Northern Rock assets' (19 Jul 2016): https://www.nao.org.uk/reports/the-13-billion-sale-of-former-northern-rock-assets/
[17] HM Treasury, 'Chancellor announces sale of Northern Rock plc' (17 Nov 2011): https://www.gov.uk/government/news/chancellor-announces-sale-of-northern-rock-plc
[18] HM Treasury, 'Final completion of record-breaking £13 billion sale of former Northern Rock mortgages' (May 2016): https://www.gov.uk/government/news/final-completion-of-record-breaking-13-billion-sale-of-former-northern-rock-mortgages
[19] Hyun Song Shin, 'Reflections on Modern Bank Runs: A Case Study of Northern Rock' (Princeton, Aug 2008): https://public.websites.umich.edu/~kathrynd/ReflectionsonModernBankRuns_PU.pdf
[20] Yale Program on Financial Stability, Northern Rock emergency liquidity case: https://newbagehot.yale.edu/node/426
[21] Associated Press via NBC News (14 Sep 2007): https://www.nbcnews.com/news/amp/wbna20771453
[22] Reuters via Mail & Guardian, 'Northern Rock CEO faces grilling on strategy' (15 Oct 2007): https://mg.co.za/article/2007-10-15-northern-rock-ceo-faces-grilling-on-strategy/
